name: post.publish_job
description: Sends one account's job of a post through the social connector (packages/connect: Instagram and Facebook through our own Meta app or Make, as `via` says): the text that account gets, the format, the post's own files, its Instagram collaborators and photo tags, its first comment, and the brand's account id on that platform, so the person's yes covers the account too. An effect: it sends only what a person approved, and the scheduler calls it at the job's time. A job that no longer waits (cancelled, sent, moved off) sends nothing. An agent sends a job only once it is due: the person's yes covers what goes out at its time, not earlier. A post with none of them sends none of the three keys, so a yes given before they existed still matches. A live job keeps the connector's note, if any (a first comment that failed after the post went out), in its error. A live job links each roster person the post names as a collaborator or a tag to the brand for good (influencer_brands, source posted).
payload: select jsonb_build_object('brand', j.brand_id, 'job', j.id, 'post', p.id, 'channel', j.channel, 'format', p.format, 'text', brandbase.text_for(p.caption, p.hook, p.draft, j.channel), 'media', brandbase.post_files(p.id), 'account', (select a.account_id from brandbase.accounts a where a.brand_id = j.brand_id and a.platform = case j.channel when 'ig' then 'instagram' when 'fb' then 'facebook' end), 'shareToFeed', case when jsonb_typeof(p.draft -> 'extra' -> 'igShareToFeed') = 'boolean' then (p.draft -> 'extra' ->> 'igShareToFeed')::boolean else true end, 'via', (select coalesce(a.details ->> 'via', 'make') from brandbase.accounts a where a.brand_id = j.brand_id and a.platform = case j.channel when 'ig' then 'instagram' when 'fb' then 'facebook' end)) || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('collaborators', nullif(case when j.channel = 'ig' and p.format <> 'story' and jsonb_typeof(p.draft -> 'details' -> 'collab') = 'array' then (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(ltrim(e.v, '@') order by e.n), '[]') from jsonb_array_elements_text(p.draft -> 'details' -> 'collab') with ordinality e (v, n)) else '[]' end, '[]'::jsonb), 'tags', case when jsonb_path_exists(case when j.channel = 'ig' and p.format <> 'story' and jsonb_typeof(p.draft -> 'shots') = 'array' then (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(case when jsonb_typeof(s.v -> 'tags') = 'array' then s.v -> 'tags' else '[]' end order by s.n), '[]') from jsonb_array_elements(p.draft -> 'shots') with ordinality s (v, n)) else '[]' end, '$[*][0]') then case when j.channel = 'ig' and p.format <> 'story' and jsonb_typeof(p.draft -> 'shots') = 'array' then (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(case when jsonb_typeof(s.v -> 'tags') = 'array' then s.v -> 'tags' else '[]' end order by s.n), '[]') from jsonb_array_elements(p.draft -> 'shots') with ordinality s (v, n)) else '[]' end end, 'comment', nullif(case when p.format <> 'story' and jsonb_typeof(p.draft -> 'details' -> 'comment') = 'string' then btrim(p.draft -> 'details' ->> 'comment') else '' end, ''))) as result from brandbase.post_jobs j join brandbase.posts p on p.id = j.post_id where j.id = :job and j.brand_id = :brand and j.status = 'scheduled'
sql:
with j as (update brandbase.post_jobs j set status = 'live', external_id = :outcome::jsonb ->> 'externalId', permalink = nullif(:outcome::jsonb ->> 'permalink', ''), error = nullif(:outcome::jsonb ->> 'note', ''), attempts = j.attempts + 1, updated_at = now() where j.id = :job and j.brand_id = :brand and j.status = 'scheduled' returning j.*), l as (update brandbase.posts p set permalink = j.permalink from j where p.id = j.post_id and p.permalink is null and j.permalink is not null and p.channels[1] = j.channel), confirmed as (
  insert into brandbase.influencer_brands as x (influencer_id, brand_id, org_id, source, post_id)
  select distinct a.influencer_id, b.id, a.org_id, 'posted', j.post_id
  from j join brandbase.posts q on q.id = j.post_id join brandbase.brands b on b.id = j.brand_id
  cross join lateral brandbase.post_handles(q.draft) as h(handle)
  join brandbase.influencer_accounts a on a.platform = 'instagram' and a.handle = h.handle and a.org_id = b.org_id
  where true
  on conflict (influencer_id, brand_id) do update set source = 'posted', post_id = excluded.post_id
  where x.source <> 'posted'
  returning x.influencer_id
) select j.id, j.status, j.external_id as "externalId" from j
